property: Both become TCP sender behaviors in modern implementations but address different pathologies: excessive tiny-segment generation versus discovery/control of network congestion capacity.

sources.locator: RFC 896 small-packet and Source Quench sections

negative_claims: The Nagle algorithm did not simply evolve into slow start.
These mechanisms should not be represented as sequential versions of one congestion-control algorithm.
open_questions: Trace when both behaviors coexist in specific BSD/vendor TCP source releases.
notes: Negative-lineage guard against a common oversimplification.
